source_instruction: i need an easy to carry tripod made of carbon fiber for my camera.
query: I just got back from scouting the first stretch of the trail I’m hiking next month, and y’all, I almost got caught in that random pop-up thunderstorm that rolled over the ridge right as I hit the first overlook? The wildflowers along the switchbacks were so bright this year, too—all those purple lupines and bright orange Indian paintbrush were popping so hard against the dark storm clouds I stopped to take a dozen phone photos even when the first raindrops started hitting my screen. I also ran into the park ranger I met on my last trip out there, and she told me the overlook at the peak is going to have unobstructed views of the valley for the next two weeks before the tree canopy fully fills in, so I’m extra stoked to get out there. Hey there, I’m looking for a tripod or monopod for my upcoming hiking trips, I need one that’s made of carbon nanotube material so it’s sturdy enough for my windy mountain overlooks, and it has to be easy carry so I don’t get sore hauling it up trails. I also need it to come with a detachable Bluetooth shutter remote that pairs with my phone, that’s a must-have for me. Oh, and I’m only looking for options that are a good deal, nothing that feels overpriced for what you get, yeah? I’m planning to order one by the end of the week so I can test it out before my trip.

come with a detachable Bluetooth shutter remote that pairs with my phone, that’s a must-have for me
